newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks reverse initial losses at midsession.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks reverse initial losses at midsession.

text.p: Madrid stocks firmed midsession on Tuesday, overturning early losses eyeing major markets abroad as players awaited the Federal Open Market Committee, dealers said.
Although no U.S. rate change is expected to come from the meeting, many are on hold just in case in order to better determine the trend short term, they said.
At 1000 GMT the general index rose 3.42 points, 0.57 percent, to 604.04. At 1100 GMT the Ibex was up 36.24 points, 0.53 percent, to 6,920.80.
Endesa was up sharply, adding 360 pesetas to 12,730 in thin trade, although dealers saw no specific new reason for the rise.
